statement: ∀ (g : X n → ℝ), Differentiable ℝ g → ∀ (x : X n) (j : Fin n), HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => g (Function.update x j z)) (fderiv ℝ g x (Pi.single j 1)) (x j)
proof:
intro g hg x j
have hf : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℝ g x) x := (hg x).hasFDerivAt
have hc := hf.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (x j) (hasDerivAt_update x j (x j))
  (by simp : x = Function.update x j (x j))
simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hc
